sources.selection_rule: one preserved Writer paragraph-spacing failure (order 77 affected) and one stable same-Adapter Writer control (order 80), selected before the live attempt and preserved in ascending source order; the control validates the shared Writer surface rather than the exact paragraph.replace_text action
sources.selection_digest_method: sha256(concat task_id values in ascending source order)

selection.method: one preserved Writer paragraph-spacing failure (order 77 affected) and one stable same-Adapter Writer control (order 80), in ascending source order; the control exercises the shared Writer service, save, and read-back surface rather than paragraph.replace_text

execution_notes: Any later supervisor invocation must explicitly include --thinking --reasoning-mode thinking; omitting --thinking is an invalid configuration and no live attempt should proceed.

diagnostic_gate.hypothesis: Writer will reject a model-submitted paragraph.replace_text or document.append_paragraphs call before mutation when explicit blank or whitespace-only paragraph strings are combined with a positive automatic blank_paragraphs_between gap; the model must then independently choose one legal representation, preserve the exact observed text, create exactly one blank paragraph after each sentence, save and read back the document, and pass the evaluator without any hidden sentence segmentation, text generation, or argument injection.
diagnostic_gate.success_criterion: Order77 remains generic_api_only, uses no retired sentence-separation macro or GUI action, reaches a legal model-selected paragraph-spacing representation, preserves exact source content while placing exactly one blank paragraph after every sentence in the first paragraph, saves, performs structural read-back, completes terminal audit, and passes the evaluator. A legal first call or a pre-mutation spacing-conflict rejection followed by a legal model replan is acceptable. Every forwarded Adapter action and semantic argument must match the raw model selection exactly, with no Runner rewrite, injection, task identity, evaluator state, sentence segmentation, replacement text, paragraph index, or spacing value supplied by the Runner. Stable order80 remains passed as a shared Writer service/save/read-back control; it is not an exact paragraph.replace_text action control.
diagnostic_gate.stop_condition: Run each task once. If order77 repeats the spacing conflict, uses GUI, changes source content or sentence boundaries incorrectly, fails terminal audit or the evaluator, if order80 or the shared Writer surface regresses, if provenance differs, or if transport or environment failure prevents a conclusive episode, stop and do not replay unchanged. A failure before the first model request because of VM or Adapter deployment is no conclusion.
